text: Appointment booking is available through the secure patient portal. The service team confirms appointment times.
Onboarding documents must be uploaded through the secure patient portal. Do not send medical records in chat.
Onboarding consent may be withdrawn by contacting the service team. Withdrawal does not replace a clinical consultation.
The administrative service team operates Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 in this fictional demonstration.
Patient privacy questions are handled by the designated privacy team through the secure patient portal.
